projects.title: SafeLang: A Memory-Safety-Focused Compiler
projects.description: A custom compiler built to understand how buffer overflow vulnerabilities happen and how compiler design can help prevent them.
goal: Understand how a compiler works from start to finish
Study how unsafe memory access leads to buffer overflow vulnerabilities
Apply secure coding ideas inside compiler design
learning: How the seven phases of a compiler work together
How unsafe memory access creates security vulnerabilities
How to build security into a language instead of adding it later
Better understanding of secure coding and low-level system behavior

projects.title: Secure Password Manager
projects.description: A Python-based password manager that generates strong passwords and stores them in encrypted form.
goal: Generate strong, random passwords
Store credentials securely using encryption
Let users save and retrieve passwords through a simple interface
learning: How encryption protects stored credentials
Why passwords should never be saved in plain text
How to generate secure, random passwords
Basics of building a secure, user-friendly application

projects.title: LegalMitra-AI
projects.description: An AI-powered legal assistant, built during a hackathon, that helps people understand their rights and take legal action against wrongful or illegal activities.
goal: Help people understand their legal options when facing wrongdoing
Make legal guidance simple and accessible using AI
Connect a legal dataset with an AI API to give relevant responses
learning: How to integrate a dataset with an AI API
How prompt engineering shapes the quality of AI responses
How badly written or malicious prompts can make an AI behave in unintended ways (prompt injection)
Why AI applications need input validation and security thinking

projects.title: Basic Sandbox (YARA File Scanner)
projects.description: A Linux-based Qt/C++ desktop application that scans files for suspicious patterns using YARA rules.
goal: Build a simple GUI tool for security-focused file scanning
Integrate YARA for pattern matching and malware-style detection
Learn how security tools are prototyped
learning: How to build a desktop GUI application with Qt and C++
How YARA rules identify patterns in files
How to integrate an external security library into an application
Basics of how malware analysis and detection tools are structured

projects.title: EmpowerPath: Safest Route Finder
projects.description: A web app that suggests the safest routes between locations in a city by showing places on a map and rating each path by safety.
goal: Help users choose safer routes instead of only the shortest ones
Show places and connections visually on a map
Apply data structures and algorithms (DFS, BFS, sorting) to a real-world problem
learning: How to model a city as a graph of places and connections
How DFS and BFS find and compare possible routes
How sorting and scoring help pick the best option
How to turn DSA concepts into a working, user-facing application

projects.title: Blood Donation Management System
projects.description: A web app that helps hospitals and blood banks manage donors, recipients, and blood donations in one place.
goal: Manage donor, recipient, and donation records efficiently
Provide user authentication and dashboards for tracking activity
Learn how databases and SQL queries work in a real application
learning: How to design a relational database with tables and relationships
How to write and run SQL queries to create, read, update, and delete data
How user authentication controls access to an application
How a database connects to a working web app

projects.title: YouTube Clone Backend
projects.description: A learning-focused backend for a YouTube-style platform with secure user accounts, video uploads, and subscription features.
goal: Build a structured REST API backend step by step
Implement secure authentication with JWT, bcrypt, and protected routes
Handle image and video uploads using Multer and Cloudinary
Design database models for users, videos, subscriptions, and watch history
learning: Building REST APIs with routes, controllers, and middleware
Hashing passwords with bcrypt and using Mongoose middleware
Implementing registration, login, logout, JWT authentication, and token refresh
Protecting routes with authentication middleware and secure cookies
Handling cookies, CORS, and HTTP headers
Using MongoDB aggregation to retrieve related data like watch history
Testing and debugging APIs with Postman and Thunder Client
